# `{ }` — Dfn / Dop

`{…}` defines a function of `⍺` and `⍵`, or an operator when it uses `⍶` or `⍹`. `;` separates its bodies. When a [predicate](question.qmd) `C?` is false, evaluation moves on to the next body. The last statement gives the result. See [Dfns](../dfns.qmd).

```bpl
{⍵×2}3             ⍝ 6
2{⍺+⍵}3            ⍝ 5
{⍵<0?-⍵;⍵}¯3       ⍝ 3
```
